!RGH20CC  # RGH is mounted from the top only: RGH20CA (the catalogue lists RGH-CA / RGH-HA)
!RGW20CA  # RGW has mounting code C (top or bottom): RGW20CC (the catalogue lists RGW-CC / RGW-HC)
!RGH15HA  # no RGH15HA row in the catalogue table (the RG15 tables list the heavy load C block only)
!RGW15HC1R160  # no RGW15HC row in the catalogue table
!RGR20T640  # bottom-mounted rail: the catalogue prints no tapped-hole dimensions for it
!RGR25R4500  # rail length 4500 mm above the maximum 4000 mm
!RGR25R60  # rail length 60 mm below the catalogue minimum 100 mm
!RGR25R1010  # rail length 1010 leaves end distance 25.00 mm, above P/2 = 15 mm and not the standard Es = 20
!RGR25R995  # end distance 17.5 mm: above the text rule E <= P/2 = 15 mm and not the standard E = 20 (p.165)
!RGR30R1020  # rail length 1020 leaves end distance 30.00 mm (P = 40: only 40 + 40n is within E = 20)
!RGW25CCZB  # the interchangeable block form has preload Z0 or ZA only (p.152)
!RGR25R640SP  # a rail ordered alone is the interchangeable rail: accuracy H or P only (p.153)
!RGH25CA1R640ZAC  # accuracy class C does not exist for RG (H, P, SP, UP)
!RGW35CC2R240  # two 124 mm blocks with the 10 mm gap do not fit on a 240 mm rail
!RGL25CA1R640  # RGL (square, low) is valid HIWIN grammar; its table is not drawn here
!RGH20CAM  # the RG chapter has no stainless option
